turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no weekday breakdown, so I can't give average daily revenue for weekends versus other days; its closest metric, Revenue (EUR), is available day by day for 17 August to 27 September 2026, and I did not average those days myself. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
